body: One more instance of the same generic-login copy, 2026-10-25T14:16Z. A plain member's **first-ever** entry into a hosted environment (after the member bounce, cloud#584) lands on the env login page titled 「欢迎回来 / 登录后继续你的工作」. That is the same objectui#12600 header copy (`zh.ts:2397`) this card already covers for the invitation landing, now on the environment host. Whatever this card does for "first visit vs returning" should cover `/_console/login` on environment hosts too. Measured on the 2026-10-25 local E2E (objectui pin `6f629a7`).
